code:
Responsible -- does the work
Accountable -- owns the decision, answers for it (exactly ONE)
Consulted   -- gives input before the decision
Informed    -- told after, no input expected
caption: One question RACI exists to answer: during a live incident, who actually gets to decide?

steps.label: Incident Commander
steps.sub: overall decision authority, coordinates the team

steps.label: Technical lead
steps.sub: runs the hands-on investigation and containment

steps.label: Comms lead
steps.sub: internal updates and, if needed, external statements

code:
Technical lead  -> Responsible (executes the isolation)
Incident Commander -> Accountable (gives the go-ahead)
Legal           -> Consulted (evidence, contract exposure)
CEO             -> Informed (told after, not asked live)
caption: One name per decision -- written down before the incident, not negotiated during it.

steps.label: No matrix
steps.sub: tech lead isolates the system on their own authority

steps.label: Same moment
steps.sub: CEO is telling someone else to keep it running

steps.label: Result
steps.sub: direct conflict, exactly what RACI exists to prevent
